headline: God of War Laufey delayed from February to May 2027
summary: Santa Monica Studio has delayed God of War Laufey's PlayStation 5 release from February 16th to May 20th, 2027. Engadget reports the studio says it will use the extra time to push the game to its fullest potential.

claims.statement: Santa Monica Studio delayed God of War Laufey's release to May 20, 2027.

sources.quote: God of War Laufey's release date is being delayed to May 20th, 2027, developer Santa Monica Studio announced today.
